title: Formal Prayer for the Pope
text:
O God, shepherd and ruler of all the faithful,
look favorably on your servant N.,
whom you have chosen as shepherd
to preside over your Church.
Grant him, we beseech you,
that by his word and example,
he may edify those over whom he presides,
so that together with the flock entrusted to him,
he may attain everlasting life.
Through Christ our Lord.
Amen.

translation.latin:
Deus, omnium fidelium pastor et rector,
famulum tuum N., quem pastorem
Ecclesiae tuae praeesse voluisti,
propitius respice:
da ei, quaesumus, verbo et exemplo,
quibus praeest, proficere,
ut ad vitam, una cum grege sibi credito,
perveniat sempiternam.
Per Christum Dominum nostrum.
Amen.

notes: This formal prayer for the Pope comes from the Roman Missal and is often used in liturgical contexts. It asks God to guide and bless the Holy Father in his role as shepherd of the universal Church. The 'N.' represents the Pope's name (currently Francis).
description: Formal liturgical prayer for the Pope from the Roman Missal
